answer: Quadratic influence over earned reputation makes splitting an operator into clones a losing trade. A seat's weight in juries and routing is its reputation squared, and reputation grows only from that address's own graded passes, at most 1 point per epoch. One seat with R = 30 has weight 900; ten fakes at 3 points each total 10 x 9 = 90, a delta of 810. Each fake earns its points through its own graded tasks, such as checking a fable translation or a solar zenith angle, so the farm does the same work for a tenth of the weight. Points can't move between addresses, so seats can't merge back.
